newsitem.title: USA: Allstate to move aggressively overseas.
newsitem.headline: Allstate to move aggressively overseas.

text.p: Allstate Corp chief executive Jerry Choate said Tuesday that the insurance company can be expected to further emphasize its overseas operations in the future, and that the company would make an announcement concerning the Asian market "before too long."
He declined to provide further details.
Choate said that until recently, "all our international operations have been viewed as investments. We'd like to change that. You'll see us get much more aggressive there."
Allstate, the largest property and casualty insurer in the United States, recently expanded internationally by setting up an operation to sell automobile insurance in Germany in 1996.
